title: YanjieZe/GMR official implementation
summary: The official MIT-licensed repository exposes the GeneralMotionRetargeting class, local human-data scaling, two-stage Mink IK loops, and LAFAN1-to-G1 task/weight tables. The inspected commit post-dates the paper and is used only as implementation evidence.

metadata.paper_version_caveat: The commit includes post-paper robot/format extensions; only mapped core symbols are used as evidence.
metadata.redistribution: No external code, configuration, assets, models, or motion data are copied into this handbook.
